candidates.title: How to PROPERLY Glute Pull Through ✅ (TRY THIS NOW) 🍑
candidates.description:
How to perfect the glute pull through 🍑

Demonstrated by Lauren.

This is an amazing exercise that’s often done improperly.

Here are a few cues:

✅ Take a step or two out from the machine
✅ Keep a slight bend in your knees
✅ Let the weight pull your hips back
✅ Squeeze your glutes at the end of the rep

If you want a more in depth video, just search “Colossus fitness glute pull throughs” and you’ll see Lauren’s full video on it. 🔥
